title: Iṣṭilāḥāt al-Ṣūfiyya or Iṣṭilāḥāt-i Ṣūfiyān ('Sufi Terminology')

date.basis: MK: 'completed before' the date of the Majlis 10196 copy (ff. 184a-88b); a copying date and only a terminus ad quem; not asterisked.

manuscript: 3 copies listed: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 184a-88b (25 Rajab 829/2 June 1426); Millī MS 2697/1 (1230/1815); Sipahsālār MS 2930/8 (undated).
summary: A list of Sufi terms in abjadī (not alifbāʾī) order.
